dog.description_text:
Chatham is a 2-year-old mixed breed who weighs around 38 pounds and is as sweet as they come. She loves meeting new people and is always eager to walk over and say hello, making fast friends wherever she goes. She's affectionate, playful, and enjoys being close to her people, happily following them from room to room to see what they're up to.

She's house-trained and making great progress with her crate training, giving her a strong foundation as she settles into a new home. Chatham has a fun, playful side and is always ready for a game, but she's just as happy keeping you company throughout the day.

If you're looking for a friendly companion who wants to be part of everything you do, Chatham is ready to bring plenty of love, fun, and loyal companionship into your life.

Approved adopters interested in Chatham can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not approved yet, apply today at hbrdogs.com.
